item.title: Rathfarnham Castle to host exhibition celebrating David Bowie

item.description: The sixth season of the popular "Ireland with Michael" program aims to "highlight the living culture of Ireland."

item.title: "He felt my pain" - Pope Leo XIV apologises to Irish abuse survivor in private audience at Vatican
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has made a heartfelt apology to abuse survivor David Ryan for the suffering he and his brother endured at the hands of paedophile Spiritan clerics in their Dublin school.

item.title: "Nothing short of a miracle" – Irish Mam hails son’s 4km ocean swim that saved their lives
